item: V18 backlog E4.4 — stage-0 tactical layer, pre-registered gates

gate_goal_fde.rule: goal FDE@4s of the SELECTED candidate < CV-extrapolated goal FDE@4s (constant velocity + heading hold from v0)
gate_goal_fde.estimator: POINT ESTIMATE over the eval grid (episodes<40, stride 8). The decision-grade interval is the PAIRED episode-cluster bootstrap (taniteval/ci.py) — POD-SIDE RESCORE REQUIRED before any registry or report claim.

gate_maneuver_f1.rule: manoeuvre 3-axis macro-F1 > the 5-way head's remapped F1
gate_maneuver_f1.note: aux heads DISABLED (weights 0, the E4.2 default) — macro_f1 null per the E4.4 brief

sel_gap_tac.rule: reported, no threshold — baseline row (V18 E4.4)
sel_gap_tac.units_note: mixed-unit fan_goal_error (m + rad + m/s) — an ORDERING quantity, never a quotable metric (tanitad/models/tactical.py fan_goal_error)

families.TACTICAL: goal FDE per tau + sel_gap_tac + (aux) 3-axis manoeuvre macro-F1 — this instrument's family
families.LATERAL: goal-point heading |err| per tau (adjunct; full curvature/yaw-rate family is the pod-side taniteval harness)
families.LONGITUDINAL: goal-point speed |err| per tau (adjunct; headway/TTC need a lead agent — pod-side)
families.STRATEGIC: n/a at stage 0 — the strategic layer is E7 (v1.9); stated per the 2026-08-02 rule

zop_window.note: DEGRADED: window 8 cannot span 30 steps — using the available stride tail (0.2 s spacing); the f_tac step stays 1 s via z_op_next
